question:
Select the figure that will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de6b71af40eb77b8eb75f3550d39c6a0801ea4f683d81157cd0be2f4afce3626.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For 'M' element → Shifting in the clockwise direction along with replacing with the consecutive next letter series according to English alphabetic series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a0cb108523337df2f94b96a2b9c87f813f957e80bb5f63d46ca352bacb2795a.png] 

2) For 'N' element → → Shifting in the clockwise direction along with replacing with the consecutive next letter series according to English alphabetic series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95025deabee38d0f484fd01a1a9969ad7feadf909dd483a6b871ecb309b84ed5.png] 

3) For ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8390f71d042352ac6d57b33dc1733a76b6a9a9bf4a7948123f3131793fb4da1b.png] ' element → Decreasing in number from to increasing in number to right side.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0ab7f1dee7814d32a2545ea0fc1c6127bbea71d6e35a001c464de35848c095e.png] 

Final series is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/848b1ca7be2d919814e4cf5f73eebd829ff6fddb556ca8996091bcc3ebb8025c.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (4)’ is the correct answer.
